Compare against an 8 KiB candidate only after gathering coverage. Use 2 KiB of unused stack on the candidate as the provisional test margin. Potential saving is 4 KiB of persistent heap reservation.

Future candidate from the Leaf 3.2.5 GPS-synced run: try 10 KiB first (2 KiB of on-state heap saved if adopted). The 12 KiB loop had 7,684 B minimum unused in the field capture. Compare 4,096, 1,024, and 512 B for host copy speed, file integrity, eject, and return of SD-card ownership to Leaf. Preserve 512 B sector transfers. Potential static RAM saving at 512 B is 3,584 B. This concerns the USB endpoint buffer.

Before approving a reduction, establish the fastest supported update rate and burst allowance, and verify that the three-second window retains its interpolation sample with jitter and rollover. Verify automatic starts, manual starts with G-load arming even when Auto Start is off, and relaunches on hardware. Keep 32 if the supported input rate cannot be bounded safely.
